title: Seismic Activation Modeling with Statistical Physics
content: Using a finite element modeling approach, it is explained how real time evolution of a seismic activation region's elastic parameters, described with a frequency dependent stiffness matrix, can be modeled in terms of statistical physics.  Postulating the relevant statistical physics model is a 2D sine-Gordon model, previously reported deviation of seismic activation earthquake occurence statistics from Gutenberg-Richter statistics in time intervals preceding a major earthquake is derived.
